examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Overline, `h1` and description, aligned to the start — the alignment that pairs with a backdrop weighted to one side.

examples.name: Highlight
examples.summary: The opening phrase painted in the brand accent. It is a `span` inside the same `h1`, so the accessible name is still the full sentence — only the paint differs.

examples.name: Centered
examples.summary: The whole block centered — for a hero whose backdrop is symmetric or that leads with one statement. The eyebrow carries a `//` prefix, set with `eyebrow-prefix`.

examples.name: MobileCentered
examples.summary: Centered below `md` only, and aligned to the start from `md` up — the alignment for a hero whose copy sits beside art on a wide screen and stacks above it on a phone. An eyebrow longer than the column wraps instead of overflowing it. Open the story on its own to see it at phone width.

examples.name: WithActions
examples.summary: The `actions` slot owns its own responsive layout, and measures its own container rather than the viewport: a content-width row from `20rem` up, wrapping when a pair is too long, and a full-width stack below it — a hero button is the page’s primary target on a 320 px screen.
